summary: OpenSSH works with BSD if you use SSH keys, but password auth relies on sshpass, which handles BSD login prompts poorly, so use paramiko for password logins via ansible.cfg or inventory variables.
questions: Why does password SSH fail on FreeBSD with Ansible?
How do I use paramiko for BSD hosts?

answer_card.title: Connect to BSD with passwords
answer_card.answer_md:
With SSH keys, the default OpenSSH works. With SSH **passwords**, Ansible uses `sshpass`, which handles BSD login prompts poorly. Use paramiko instead:
```ini
[freebsd]
myfreebsdhost ansible_connection=paramiko
```
(or set it globally in `ansible.cfg`).
